default/31747.htm.text: Pure White Unicorn: The unicorn seems to be feeling better, although it still looks a bit weak and faltering. For some reason, when I caress it, the familiar face of a blonde woman comes to mind...

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/31747-0.text: Pure White Unicorn: [A familiar female voice] Thank you for your help... I'm too weak now to return to my original state, but don't worry. It's too dangerous for you to stay any longer. You must go back to Kassandra and her grandfather.
Pure White Unicorn: [A familiar female voice] Hurry and return to the Dwarven girl, Kassandra.
